name: B站视频下载
description: 下载当前/指定B站视频为单个 MP4 文件（音视频已合成，720P，落盘到浏览器下载目录）。仅下载你有权限访问的内容。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 视频页链接（bilibili.com/video/BV...）；不填则在当前标签页上下载

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isVideo=()=>/bilibili\.com\/video\/BV/.test(location.href);if(target&&!(isVideo()&&location.href.indexOf(target.split('?')[0])>=0)){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isVideo())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}if(!isVideo())return {ok:false,error:'not-on-video-page',hint:'当前标签不在B站视频页（bilibili.com/video/BV...）；请先打开视频页再运行本模板，或通过 params.url 传入视频链接。'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const bvid=(location.href.match(/BV[0-9A-Za-z]+/)||[])[0];if(!bvid)return {ok:false,error:'no-bvid'};const pl=await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/pagelist?bvid='+bvid,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json());if(pl.code!==0||!pl.data||!pl.data.length)return {ok:false,error:'pagelist-failed',detail:pl.message||('code '+pl.code)};const page=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number('$page')||1,pl.data.length));const cid=pl.data[page-1].cid;const api='https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/playurl?bvid='+bvid+'&cid='+cid+'&qn=116&platform=html5&high_quality=1';const pj=await fetch(api,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json());if(pj.code!==0||!pj.data||!pj.data.durl||!pj.data.durl[0])return {ok:false,error:'playurl-failed',detail:pj.message||('code '+pj.code),hint:'该视频可能不支持HTML5单文件导出（互动视频/充电专属/版权限制等）'};const du=pj.data.durl[0];if(du.size>2147483648)return {ok:false,error:'too-large',sizeMB:Math.round(du.size/1048576),hint:'超过2GB上限，请选择更短的视频或分P'};const blob=await fetch(du.url).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.blob();});const title=(document.title.replace(/_哔哩哔哩[_ ]?bilibili.*$/i,'').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_').trim())||bvid;const QMAP={16:'360P',32:'480P',64:'720P',74:'720P60',80:'1080P',112:'1080P+'};const q=QMAP[pj.data.quality]||((pj.data.format||'mp4').replace(/^mp4/,'')+'P');const filename=title+'_'+q+'.mp4';const objUrl=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=objUrl;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(()=>{a.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);},120000);return {ok:true,downloaded:true,filename:filename,sizeMB:Math.round(blob.size/1048576*10)/10,quality:pj.data.quality,page:page,bvid:bvid,title:title};})()

body.note: 解析 bvid/cid → playurl(HTML5 单文件) → 页面内拉流 → 浏览器另存

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: 落盘文件名（浏览器下载目录）
